summary: Unnamed contact who is a business associate of "Alex" (the phone owner's partner) and works as a longtime Google Ads specialist (self-described "27 year Google ads guy"). Over 6/17-6/19/2026 he coordinated emergency remediation of four hacked websites — two on GoDaddy hosting, two on Pressable (his server) — handing over credentials so Derrick's dev team could clear an IP/vendor blacklist and move the sites behind Cloudflare. GoDaddy claimed the sites were targeted in an attack and refused to remove malicious code because a GoDaddy template was used, so the plan shifted to buying two new domains and migrating the sites. As of 6/19 all four sites were reported down after the Cloudflare change and he was waiting on instruction for when to change DNS — needs follow-up to confirm the sites came back up.
